title: Record the value that doubles register 39 to -4
body:
## Summary
- Immediately before event 24284, register 354 holds `-1` when register 359 starts at `1`. Its last write is event 20745. The data register contributes `0`.
- The addition multiplies that value by `2` and contributes `-2`. Register 39 holds `-2`, so the sum is `-4`.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. Changes of register 39 after this addition are not scanned.
